title: Influence bound for bounded functions
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^q\to\mathbb R$ take values in $[-1,1]$. For every coordinate $i\in[q]$, its influence, defined as the uniform average of the square of the discrete derivative in coordinate $i$, is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a bounded cube function, with all values in [−1,1]
